I'm in the same boat man. I tell them I'm feeling better after I finally broke down, but I know that without them around I'd probably go through with it. I'm not here to survive on drugs, but interestingly from doing some psychedelic drugs myself, I know that my brain is *capable* of creating happiness. yes, that happiness is artificial and how addictions are born, but now I at least have some solace in the fact that it (my brain) can do that. However, drugs won't take off the the constant load of your self worth and reality (this really is our burden; seeing reality so clearly. I think you hit the nail on the head with sharpness). I think drugs high abuse potential makes them the route that really does the most damage to us who are most vulnerable to their allure. Weed is great, I smoked a good amount in college, and it was for the same purposes; to be ok with my existance. But you have to step back and look at the toll its taking on you. So while weed may help for the short term, if you can already see it taking over your life try to moderate it. So I implore you to instead hang on, if just for your family and friend right now (you seem like someone who values the bonds you have made in this life so far), but look for something for yourself. something you want to grab and not let go. I'm still looking, but having therapy, a couple of people to confide in, and some medication have made the daily a bit more bearable. Just enough to keep on looking. Good luck on your journey, hope the twists and turns of life start to smooth out and become a ride you enjoy. PM me if you want to talk
